description: This file implements the FieldIdAssignmentHelper class responsible for assigning and managing field identifiers for serialization purposes within the Orleans code generator. It handles extracting member data, applying annotations, generating implicit IDs, and managing symbol mappings.

classes.name: FieldIdAssignmentHelper
classes.description: Internal helper class for assigning unique identifiers to fields and properties of a type for serialization, including handling annotations and implicit ID generation.

methods.name: TryGetSymbolKey
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the field ID and flag for a given symbol from the internal dictionary.

methods.name: HasMemberWithIdAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if any member has an explicit ID annotation.

methods.name: GetMembers
methods.description: Retrieves all serializable member symbols (fields and properties), excluding static, abstract, or non-serializable members.

methods.name: ExtractFieldIdAnnotations
methods.description: Extracts and assigns IDs based on annotations present on members, or defaults where annotations are absent.

methods.name: GetCanonicalNameAndFieldId
methods.description: Computes a canonical name and a hash-based field ID from a type and member name.

methods.name: GenerateImplicitFieldIds
methods.description: Generates implicit field IDs for members based on hashing type and member names, applying selection strategies and ensuring collision safety.

methods.name: GenerateFromProperties
methods.description: Helper function to generate IDs from property members, ensuring consistency with constructor parameters and handling read-only properties.
